definitions.value: bin range after the real _fuse_static_and_extract_obstacles (camera_no_return_to_lidar_range: column value >= 10 m -> 12 m no-return), 13 in-FOV 5-deg bins, bearings +30..-30 deg (left..right)
definitions.native: S2b-FT: min over all 234 rows of ONE trained column camera_u per bin
definitions.sector: S3-W rule 2: 24th-smallest over every pixel of the 20-28 columns whose bearing lies in the bin
definitions.all/nonsky: nonsky = the same frame with sky_mask_heuristic pixels flagged invalid before projection
definitions.near_rate: share of frame-bins with value < T (all pixels)
definitions.sky_phantom_rate: share of frame-bins with value < T that are >= T once sky pixels are invalid (the near reading exists only because of sky pixels)
definitions.nonsky_near_rate: share of frame-bins < T without sky pixels (real objects, ground, other non-sky)
definitions.near_with_sky_min_pixel_rate: native: near and the column-minimum trained pixel took its value from a sky pixel
definitions.near_with_majority_sky_k_nearest_rate: sector: near and >= 50 % of the pixels at or below the 24th value are sky-sourced

runtime_path: CameraPolicyRuntime.preprocess -> _preprocess_cams2 (CAM-S2 contract; the outdoor profile is refused for CAM-S2)

project_rgbd_min_valid (v2): depth 0 / z<MinZ 0.315 -> sensor-invalid, z>MaxZ 20 -> no-return; valid samples rotated by the estimator roll/pitch (yaw removed) into the level 312x234 trained camera (fx 237.04, cx 155.5); each trained pixel = MIN optical z over valid samples landing on it, stored as ray range z/cos

remove_floor_and_ceiling: floor ON by default (margin 0.10 m; valid returns with hit_z < margin -> no-return; needs the operator estimator-height assertion); ceiling OFF by default, optional physical ceiling (--ceiling-height-m) removes valid returns with hit_z > height - 0.10; invalid_plane_rule OFF
no sky rule, no blob_near, no 40x24 coarse render on real depth (open item P1-3); every pixel without a valid return -> perception.max_camera_range 20 m

perception._fuse_static_and_extract_obstacles: column min over 234 rows; camera_no_return_to_lidar_range maps column values >= camera_obstacle_max_range 10 m to the 12 m no-return; 13 bins read one column each (native); S3-W replaces each bin by the 24th-smallest over its 20-28 columns (navrl_cams3 rule 2)
tools/camera_policy_runtime.py has no cams3 hook: S3-W flight path NOT_IMPLEMENTED in the runtime (analysis installs navrl_cams3.install_sector on the same perception)
emulated: contract dict hand-built with the CAM-S2 formulas (no receipt/checkpoint): camera 312x234 66.7x52.6 deg, translation [0.08,0,0.03], MinZ 0.315, MaxZ 20; ground/ceiling blocks per config
estimator_height assertion bound to a local note (estimator_height_assumption.txt): camera height ASSUMED 1.5 m (vehicle team ESTIMATE, not taped) unless the config says otherwise
state: yaw 0, roll/pitch from the mean PX4 accelerometer over +-0.5 s (no bias/mount calibration)
frame: depth_mm/1000 as optical z, invalid = depth 0, camera_to_body = identity (level mount), mount = trained translation, intrinsics fx=fy=473.8 cx 309.5 cy 246.7
_preprocess_cams2 absent -> 20 m (3 lines) repeated in scanlib.filtered_depth

perception built like CameraPolicyRuntime.__init__ from the S2b-FT receipt flight environment (no checkpoint); fuse called directly with target_pixels all False (the real drone is not carved: no red detection)
sky = vehicle-team sky_mask_heuristic (bright+blue in the upper half); nonsky variant flags it invalid
shift_test: sub-bin yaw emulated by a horizontal image shift
meta.visual_check: phantom_examples.png, 6 native T5 phantoms (Gm0.5) [VISUAL]: 1 on the stadium roof that the sky heuristic labels sky (structure is far, 4.54 m reading is false anyway), 4 among thin branches against bright sky (stereo spill from branches or branch returns; not separable), 1 in sun glare beside the treeC trunk. The sky label is a heuristic, so "sky phantom" = near value from pixels the heuristic calls sky.

q1_sky.note: G1.5 = contract-default floor filter at the ESTIMATED 1.5 m (ceiling off, CAM-S2 default); Gm0.5 = floor filter margin 0.5 m (ground-suppressed reference so that grass does not mask sky phantoms); C3.0/C2.5 = physical ceiling filter (--ceiling-height-m) at 3.0/2.5 m with the 1.5 m camera height

q2_stops.note: class vs taped: ok if |v - taped| <= max(0.3 m, 20 %); too_near/too_far beyond; missed_no_return if the bin reads the 12 m no-return (column value >= 10 m). Drone boxes come from drone_stop_frames (other frames of the same stop). treeB has no taped distance (NOT_MEASURED).

subbin_shift_test.note:
Thin-object sub-bin test (EMULATED yaw): the taped trunk/pole stop frames are shifted horizontally by s source pixels
(s = -20..+20, ~ +-2.4 deg, about one 5-deg bin pitch = 41.5 px; new[:, x] = old[:, x - s], vacated columns invalid),
then replayed through the same runtime projection + floor filter + real fuse (native / sector k=24). A pure shift
approximates a small yaw (error < 0.1 px near the centre). For each shift: the bin whose bearing range contains the
shifted object centre, and the minimum over all bins the object overlaps.
  seen      : reading within max(0.3 m, 20 %) of the vehicle team's trunk depth (the object itself)
  not_far   : reading <= trunk depth + tolerance (the object or something nearer)
Writes shift_test.json.

overall.note: attitude = mean PX4 accelerometer (body FLU) over +-0.5 s; no accelerometer-bias or camera-to-FC mount calibration; walking adds linear acceleration

q3_attitude.note_compare: L_* = level (roll = pitch = 0); P_* = measured pitch with roll 0

ground_filter_sweep.note: nonsky variant (sky removed) so only ground/objects remain; "near_not_in_Gm0.5" = near only because the floor filter (assumed height, margin 0.1 m) kept low ground returns that the 0.5 m margin removes
